answer: The ember assignment is published and jade records each panel. Shards are assigned from the signal graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3467 identities would post 2948 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
